Two steps for creating your own luck, as Kevin teaches them.

Kevin explains the first step: know exactly what you want. The second is to release attachment to the outcome. He points out that things tend to happen when you least expect them, because that is when you have let go of the grip.

Wanting something with desperation puts you out of alignment. Letting go of the need puts you back in it.

Which of the two steps is harder for you, knowing what you want or letting go of it?

#ad #luck #mindset #success

Smart or lucky? A very wealthy man answered without hesitating.

Kevin tells the story of asking his business partner in Australia that exact question. The man said he was smart too, but luck was the bigger part, and that it is always better to be lucky because you can only be so smart.

He also knew something else: you can create your own luck.

Would you rather be smart or lucky?

#ad #luck #success #wealth

Working on your luck changes more than your luck.

Kevin says that as you start becoming luckier, you feel better about yourself. Confidence, self-image and self-esteem go up, and people start treating you differently. Peace, joy and happiness come to the surface.

His closing line: luck is really alignment.

Which of these would you most like to grow?
